provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: An optically uniform plane-parallel film has unknown positive thickness d and constant real refractive index n>1 in this measured band. Normal-incidence adjacent interference maxima have wavenumber spacing1/(2*n*d), with d in cm. At external angle theta, Snell law gives sin(theta_internal)=sin(theta)/n and spacing1/(2*n*d*cos(theta_internal)). Both observations refer to the same film and same dispersion-free band; reflection phase offsets are constant with wavenumber and do not affect adjacent spacings.
scope: Invert this controlled coherent-fringe model only; no roughness, absorption, birefringence, thickness gradients or wavelength-dependent index fitting.
